audio_role: Upbeat instrumental Latin jazz with nylon guitar, walking bass and light shaker/percussion, no voice, no sizzle. Continuous cheerful terrace mood; the 5 hard plate swaps land on or near music beats to feel like flipping menu pages.
can_make: We can rebuild it as a composite without the bite: 1) background: house cast model seated at wood table in terrace look, smiling with eyes open, holding empty fork up or hands on table, never eating. 2) foreground: real menu photo of each dessert cut out onto a white plate, large at bottom frame. 3) motion: 4s AI clips started from that composite with only very slow push-in to give life, no chewing or spoon-to-mouth. 4) edit: hard cut every ~2s to swap dessert + yellow label. What breaks: we cannot copy the core eating pose because our cast never eats, so no spoon at lips, no closed-eyes tasting moment.
core: One eater holds the same about-to-taste bite while five different desserts replace each other on the table in front of her.
dish: Waffle de Manzana y Toffee, Alfajor, Cheesecake de Frutos Rojos, Crema Volteada, Enrollado de Chirimoya
fits: Single-serve plated sweets that read in 2 seconds from the front: waffle with ice cream, cake/cheesecake slice, flan, cookie sandwich, rolled cake. Needs to hold shape on a plate. Does not suit soups, drinks, large sharing plates, or food that needs cutting, pouring or stretching to understand.
hook: First second: eye-level medium of a young woman eyes closed, mouth open, spoon with berries touching her lips, with a caramel waffle and ice cream large on a plate in foreground.
needs_camera: The real tasting proof: a real person in a real place actually bringing spoon to mouth, closing eyes, chewing, with consistent light, real terrace plants/buildings and real hand tension. Also a long unbroken take that proves the same person saw all five plates. AI cast and photo composite cannot show eating, mouth contact, or genuine reaction.
people: One woman mid-20s, long dark wavy hair, sunglasses on head, gold hoops, white tee + grey knit cardigan, seated at wood table outdoors. She stays frozen whole Reel: right hand holds spoon to open mouth, left hand rests on table, eyes closed smiling. No talking, no carrying, no movement.

why_it_works: Foreground dessert is big, sharp and wet-looking - sauce, ice cream, berries - and background face with closed eyes and spoon at mouth signals tasting pleasure. Viewer gets product + reaction in one frame, repeated 5 times fast, so hunger comes from gloss plus human proof and variety creates a reason to choose.
